subject.title: [Feature]: Standardize skill data directory convention (configPaths) under ~/.openclaw/

question: Should OpenClaw define a first-class writable data directory contract for skills, and if so should it be a filesystem convention, a plugin/skill data API, or ClawHub authoring guidance only?
rationale: The source confirms the requested capability is missing, but choosing the storage owner creates a durable API and compatibility surface that automation should not invent.

options.title: Design a generic skill data contract
options.body: Define the storage semantics and then add the smallest metadata/API/docs surface that skill authors can rely on.

options.title: Use ClawHub authoring guidance only
options.body: Document a recommended package convention without making OpenClaw create or expose runtime writable directories.

options.title: Prefer existing plugin/state APIs
options.body: Route durable state through plugin KV or SQLite-backed APIs instead of adding a new filesystem convention.

recommendation.title: Design a generic skill data contract
recommendation.body: Define the storage semantics and then add the smallest metadata/API/docs surface that skill authors can rely on.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to recent skill install/runtime documentation and earlier ClawHub skill install flow work among the inspected history.
